releases.name: opencode-vim v0.7.0
releases.body:
Target the tested OpenCode 2.0.30 host contract with matched renderer and theme dependencies.

Users retaining OpenCode 2.0.28 should retain Vim 0.6.0.

Changes: [#272](https://github.com/naxodev/ai/pull/272).

issues.title: test(opencode-vim): establish native Windows integration evidence
fix(opencode-vim): investigate extra deletion after leaving visual mode
chore(roadmap): track repository reliability and OSS improvements
test(opencode): cover documented package-name plugin installation
